## What changed

Describe the user-visible behavior and the reason for the change.

## How it was tested

- [ ] `make check`
- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] I tested the affected interaction in the macOS app when the change touches UI or capture behavior.

## Release and privacy check

- [ ] No capture, credential, signing file, personal path, or build artifact is included.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when needed.
- [ ] New file, preference, or system API use is reflected in the privacy documentation when needed.
